status: Authorized matched ungated baselines; frozen before baseline outcomes
authorization: 2026-10-21 user requests comparison to the most basic ungated DiscoLoop and ordinary Loop.
question: Does invariant outperform ordinary Loop and fixed-alpha=1 DiscoLoop with identical training and data, including new initializations, changed data and extra inference rounds?

input_origin.reuse: Exact existing 40000-example world and 43000-query panels used by every DiscoLoop/gate multi-hop arm

paired_recipe.note: Reuse the invariant condition backbone, data, sample stream and random-round sequence; only recurrence changes.

A0-discoloop-old-recipe.recipe: fixed R=4, final-round answer/EOS CE, constant LR after warmup, AdamW betas (0.9, 0.999), no EMA, CUDA graph

primary: At the 1500000-step endpoint with EMA weights: graph-B two/three/four-hop full-vocabulary answer accuracy at R8 from the R1-32 trace; also R4, R16, R32, graph-A held-out four-hop, all 11 panels, answer+EOS at R4/8/16/32, raw weights, and the full learning curves at R4/R8. No best checkpoint or horizon is selected.

comparisons.recipe: recipe-additive vs reused A0: InfiLoop-style training (random rounds, deep supervision, cosine LR, beta2 0.95, EMA) with the unchanged DiscoLoop handoff
comparisons.carry: ema vs recipe-additive: normalized convex carry with constant score versus additive carry, same recipe
comparisons.content_score: content vs ema: InfiLoop's identity-readable pseudo-query score
comparisons.invariance: invariant vs content: relabeling-invariant score versus identity-readable score
